_meta.purpose: Ground truth for the gateway provider registry. Every GatewayAction's input_schema in src/integrations/gateway_actions/ must equal the inputSchema here. Increment 3 shipped seven Gmail action ids that did not exist in OpenConnector and it only surfaced on a live call; this fixture is the mechanical gate against a repeat.
_meta.regenerate: Run OpenConnector, then curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' http://localhost:3001/api/actions and select these ids. See infra/gateway/spike-findings-multiprovider.md.

github.list_repository_issues.description: List issues for a GitHub repository. Pull requests are filtered out of the response; pageInfo.fetched reports the raw page length before filtering, so paginating callers must continue while fetched equals perPage (30 by default) even when the issues array comes back short or empty.

perPage.description: Number of results requested per page. Defaults to 30.

fetched.description: Number of items GitHub returned on this page before filtering. Continue paginating while this equals perPage, which defaults to 30.

pageInfo.description: Pagination signals from the raw GitHub page, before pull requests are filtered out.
